_comment: Ground truth from Factorio 2.1.23 (build 87750, linux64, headless) for the seed-derived bearing chain, on 606 map seeds: 600 random (Python random.Random(7531)) plus 0, 1, 2, 4294967295, 16777217 and 4294967294. Each seed got its own surface (game.create_surface with that seed) and one calculate_tile_properties call at (0, 0) read these named noise expressions, which copy the Vulcanus definitions in planet-vulcanus-map-gen.lua. Every number is the f32 the game computed, printed with %.17g so it reads back exactly. Fields: seed; msn = map_seed_normalized; dir = -1 + 2 * (map_seed_small & 1); ash = msn * 3600; mtn = ash + 120 * dir; bas = ash + 240 * dir; prot_deg = mtn + 180 * dir; bas_sin, bas_cos = sin and cos of bas / 180 * pi; prot_sin, prot_cos = the same for prot_deg; fg_deg = map_seed / 360; fg_sin = sin(map_seed / 360 / 180 * pi). Captured by scripts/probes/bearing-chain. Graded by test/bearingChain.spec.ts and the fixtures tests in crates/fmw-noise.
